project_type: Python WiFi reconnaissance and attack framework
build_system: setup.py with no build step required
test_framework: No test suite present - validation by AST syntax check
test_command: python3 -c "import ast; import os; files=[f for f in os.listdir('posframework') if f.endswith('.py')]; [ast.parse(open(f'posframework/{f}').read()) for f in files]"
verification_instructions: Run AST parse on all .py files in posframework/
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no pip install, no Docker. Use pre-installed Python for AST/syntax validation only.
contribution_requirements: Commit to existing branch fix/complete-audit-fixes and push. PR #1 is already open.
key_patterns: Each module is a class with start()/stop() methods. Uses scapy for packet manipulation. Logging via config.log. Cross-platform via IS_WINDOWS/IS_LINUX flags. Database access via POSDatabase instance. Orchestrator integrates all modules. Threads are daemon=True with join(timeout=5) in stop().
directory_structure: posframework/ contains all modules. Each module is a single .py file with one or more classes. config.py has shared constants/logging. __main__.py is the CLI entry point. orchestrator.py coordinates all attack modules.
